thread:
Priya Shah: Customer running JSON mode for a nested-array response is getting intermittent 'Invalid JSON' errors. They say some array items are missing required keys and sometimes extra keys appear — downstream parser chokes. Can we escalate and repro? They provided an example and it's failing in production 5-10% of requests.

Alex Nguyen: Thanks — can you paste the raw request body + headers (sanitized keys ok)? Also which model + api params (json_mode, temperature, max_tokens, etc)?

Priya Shah: Here's what they send (sanitized):
```json
POST /v1/generate
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
{
  "model": "redwood-alpha-1",
  "json_mode": "structured",
  "schema": {
    "type": "array",
    "items": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["id","value","metrics"],
      "properties": {
        "id": {"type":"string"},
        "value": {"type":"number"},
        "metrics": {"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["name","v"]}}
      }
    }
  },
  "input": "summarize dataset",
  "max_tokens": 400
}
```
Response occasionally fails with: `400 Bad Request` + body: `{
  "error": "Invalid JSON: extra key 'metadata' in item 2 of array at line 1"
}`

Priya Shah: Customer also attached a sample model output that sometimes returns an item like `{"id":"a1","value":null,"metadata":{"source":"ingest"}}` (missing metrics, extra metadata). Their downstream consumer expects exact ordering of keys inside objects too and fails when order changes.

Chen Li: Hmm — two issues surfaced: partial objects (missing 'metrics') and extra keys ('metadata'). Structured mode should validate but tolerances depend on strictness flag. Do we currently enforce required fields at decode time or only in post-validate step?

Alex Nguyen: We validate after generation and before returning to user. But there's a known edge where streaming + buffer flushing can emit partial items if the model returns truncated tokens or hallucinated commas, and our JSON reassembly can mis-handle trailing commas between array items which then shifts keys/order. Have we seen this pattern with alpha models before?

Priya Shah: Customer says errors spike under higher latency / token-rate bursts — aligns with streaming boundary theory. They get success 90-95% and 5-10% of items are malformed.

Chen Li: Repro plan: replicate with streaming enabled and reduced max_tokens fragmentation. I'll run a local experiment with `--stream=true` and low chunk size to try to reproduce partial object emission. Also will try toggling strict schema enforcement flags.

Alex Nguyen: For immediate mitigation advise customer to set `json_mode_options: { "tolerate_extra_keys": true, "require_all_required": false }` if available. If not, the short-term workaround is to post-process and drop unknown keys and skip items missing metrics. But we need fix server-side so this doesn't eat retries/billing.

Billing Team: FYI — the customer is worried about the retries increasing cost. If this is confirmed service-side, please flag for a credits review.

Chen Li: I ran a quick local loop (50 requests) with streaming chunk size forced to 64 bytes and saw ~6% malformed items — missing metrics object or an extra metadata field injected mid-stream. Repro snippet below: 
```bash
for i in {1..50}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer TEST' -d @payload.json | jq . || echo "PARSE_FAIL $i"
done
```
Output: 3 PARSE_FAIL lines, captured outputs show trailing `,` and an orphaned `"metadata":{...}` inside item 4.
```
{"id":"x","value":12.3,"metrics":[{"name":"a","v":1}]},
{"id":"y","value":5.6,"metadata":{"source":"ingest"}}
```

Alex Nguyen: Good repro. Root cause hypothesis: our streaming reassembly logic treats `},
{` boundaries and re-parses chunks; if chunk breaks inside an object's closing brace the tokenizer/state machine may mistakenly splice tokens leading to a shifted object. Fix could be to buffer until a full JSON token boundary detected before emitting to validator.

Chen Li: I'll open ENG task to make streaming assembler wait for top-level item boundary before handing to JSON mode validator. In parallel I'll add a temporary countermeasure: when schema validation fails, run a conservative cleanup pass to remove keys not in schema and auto-fill required missing fields with null (configurable).

Priya Shah: Customer asked for repro steps to validate on their side — can you share the exact payload options to reproduce?

Chen Li: Share payload.json (sanitized) and run the curl loop above. Use `json_mode: structured`, `stream: true`, `stream_chunk_size: 64`, `model: redwood-alpha-1`, `max_tokens: 400`. Also include header `X-Debug-Mode: json-verbose` to get parsing diagnostics. I'll attach logs to the ENG ticket.

Alex Nguyen: Added labels: sev=high (customer impact), area=streaming, component=json-mode. Assigning to @chen for the fix.

oncall-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026. Link: https://internal.redwood/INC-2026 (created by Chen Li)

Billing Team: Please hold on credits until ENG confirms root cause and ETA.

Priya Shah: Thanks — will update customer with the workaround and the incident link. Will follow up if they want credits. :thumbsup:
